BeforeHandDraw.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): `_return_to_hand_if_played_last_turn` searches the EXHAUST pile too. Bolas.cs:43-47 and the byte-identical ThrummingHatchet.cs:37-41 test only `pile == null || pile.Type != PileType.Hand` and then `CardPileCmd.Add(this, PileType.Hand)`, which moves the card from wherever it is; searching only draw and discard silently stranded an exhausted card, and card/brand, card/burning_pact, card/second_wind and card/fiend_fire are four ported ways to exhaust one from hand. EXECUTED: played, then exhausted, the card is back in hand at the next turn start and out of the exhaust pile.  Pinned by test/test_card_residue_gaps.py.  The two cards share the sim helper exactly as they share the C# body (rule 3). NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site.  The text it replaced read: This card SHARES card/bolas's return-to-hand helper, and the two C# implementations are byte-identical (ThrummingHatchet.cs:33-43 vs Bolas.cs:39-49), so the finding transfers verbatim and carries the same verdict (rule 3). The trigger condition and the pre-draw slot are faithful: `History.CardPlaysFinished.Any(e => e.HappenedLastPlayerTurn(Owner) && e.CardPlay.Card == this)` == the sim's `e.card is card and e.turn == combat.turn - 1` over `CardPlayedEntry`. THE PILE SEARCH IS NOT: C# tests only `pile == null || pile.Type != PileType.Hand` and then calls `CardPileCmd.Add(this, PileType.Hand)`, which moves the card to hand from WHEREVER it is -- including the EXHAUST pile -- while the sim's helper searches only `(player.draw_pile, player.discard_pile)` (colorless_attacks.py:532-535) and silently gives up otherwise. Observable: play Thrumming Hatchet, then exhaust it -- next turn the game returns it to hand and the sim does not. LIVE: card/brand and card/burning_pact are ported hand-exhausters that pass a NULL filter, and card/second_wind and card/fiend_fire exhaust the hand wholesale.
